title: Dimension a part in one call and prove it is complete
summary: Dimension every edge, hole and arc of a part with one dimension_auto call on its layer, check the dimensions do not overlap, and prove a second run would draw nothing - never one dimension_* call per feature.

notes: dimension_auto reads LINE runs, LWPOLYLINE edges, CIRCLE diameters and ARC radii; an ELLIPSE, a SPLINE or anything else it cannot dimension comes back in omitted with its reason, never dropped.
The second dimension_auto call is the completeness check: with skip_existing (the default) it binds every candidate to the DIMENSION already measuring it, so it must create nothing.
A machine part drawn by mech_part_draw is dimensioned by mech_dimension_part instead; this recipe is for geometry somebody drew as plain entities.

drawing.description: The drawing that holds the part (millimetres).

layer.description: The layer the part's geometry is on.

steps.purpose: Open the drawing with the part.
Every edge, hole diameter, arc radius and the overall size of the part, in one call.

steps.purpose: The completeness check: a rerun finds every feature already dimensioned.

postconditions.says: Every selected entity could be dimensioned; nothing was left out.
A second run draws nothing: the part is completely dimensioned.
